title: Authorize client access limits with live client-limit authority and bounded limit-type and value validation
description: Stage 3 access-control closure for the client access limits that the System settings page manages. src/ERP.Api/Controllers/SysSimpleControllers.cs:15-21 declares ClientLimitController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/sys/client-limits)]/[Authorize] and no overrides, so every route is inherited unguarded from src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:37-92 (GetPaged 38-43, GetAll 46-51, GetById 53-59, Create 62-67, Update 69-76, Delete 79-84 and BatchDelete 87-92) and delegates to IGenericService (src/ERP.Application/Services/GenericService.cs) with zero identity or menu resolution, so any authenticated account can list, mint, edit or soft-delete the client access limits. The sibling controller in the same file, DocumentNumberRuleController (src/ERP.Api/Controllers/SysSimpleControllers.cs:33-124, ERP-445), already demonstrates the required override-with-live-authorization pattern; reuse the existing 客户端限制 (client-limit, src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:21) functional menu on every route and add bounded server-side validation for the persisted SysClientLimit columns (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysSystem.cs:94-109) plus limit-type/value normalization, keeping the generic BaseCrudController contract, the soft-delete semantics for every other derived controller and the existing OperationLogController (same file, lines 126-180) behaviour unchanged. No Domain/Infrastructure/schema change, no grant, no anonymous/admin fallback. Genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST SQL only; safe Release build plus full ERP.UnitTests. All entry points including in-process controllers must enforce live authorization. Adapt legacy fixtures by seeding an enabled identity and existing menu grants in the isolated test context; never gate authorization on Request.Path, environment, fake identity, or an empty request to bypass checks.
acceptance_criteria: For every route on /api/sys/client-limits (paged, all, by-id, create, update, delete and batch delete) require the current enabled nondeleted identity and the existing client-limit functional menu before any read or write, rejecting missing, disabled, deleted and revoked-menu identities with the existing controlled non-disclosing errors and adding no new grants or anonymous/admin fallback.

Validate on create and update that LimitValue is non-empty and within its persisted length bound, that LimitType is a known client-limit type, that Remark stays within its persisted bound and that a non-empty batch-delete id list never removes rows on denial, so a rejected write persists no SysClientLimit change and the generic BaseCrudController soft-delete contract stays unchanged for every other derived controller.

Genuine isolated SQL authenticated controller tests cover the permitted privileged and menu-granted flows, missing client-limit menu, disabled, deleted and revoked identities and invalid limit-type, over-long limit-value and remark payloads, and assert that denied paged, all, by-id, create, update, delete and batch-delete calls read or mutate no SysClientLimit row while the existing OperationLogTests contracts (OperationLogController shares src/ERP.Api/Controllers/SysSimpleControllers.cs) stay green.

Keep the safe Release build and the full existing ERP.UnitTests suite green, use only genuine isolated (localdb)\\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST databases with Integrated Security, and add no schema, entity, menu, permission or production/secret change; build completion is not stage acceptance.
implementation_evidence: src/ERP.Api/Controllers/SysSimpleControllers.cs:15-21 declares ClientLimitController with only [ApiController]/[Route(api/sys/client-limits)]/[Authorize] and no overrides, so all routes are inherited unguarded from src/ERP.Api/Controllers/BaseCrudController.cs:37-92 (GetPaged 38-43, GetAll 46-51, GetById 53-59, Create 62-67, Update 69-76, Delete 79-84, BatchDelete 87-92) which call IGenericService (src/ERP.Application/Services/GenericService.cs) with zero Authoriz/Menu references. SysClientLimit (src/ERP.Domain/Entities/SysSystem.cs:94-109) persists LimitType(97), LimitValue(100-101, Required MaxLength 200), IsEnabled(104) and Remark(107-108, MaxLength 500) with only attribute annotations. The re-used existing menu is seeded at src/ERP.Infrastructure/Data/SeedData.Menus.cs:21 and the page is registered at src/ERP.Api/wwwroot/js/modules-doc.js:69 (app.js:321 icon map). The required override pattern already exists in the same file at DocumentNumberRuleController (src/ERP.Api/Controllers/SysSimpleControllers.cs:33-124, ERP-445 with src/ERP.Application/Services/DocumentNumberRuleAuthorizationRules.cs) and the same-file regression contract is src/ERP.UnitTests/OperationLogTests.cs (OperationLogController at SysSimpleControllers.cs:126-180). There is no ClientLimitAuthorizationRules in src/ERP.Application/Services and an exact search of .ai/tasks returns no task listing ClientLimitController or SysClientLimit for live authorization.
